SELECT
    CalendarYear,
    total_sales,
    round(
        (total_sales - previous_year_sales) * 100.0 / nullIf(previous_year_sales, 0),
        2
    ) AS yoy_growth_pct
FROM
(
    SELECT
        d.CalendarYear AS CalendarYear,
        sum(f.SalesAmount) AS total_sales,
        lagInFrame(sum(f.SalesAmount), 1) OVER (ORDER BY d.CalendarYear) AS previous_year_sales
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS f
    INNER JOIN retail.DimDate AS d
        ON f.DateKey = d.DateKey
    GROUP BY d.CalendarYear
)
ORDER BY CalendarYear;
